engineering.title: Engineering
engineering.subtitle: Resilient backend services, payment integrations and blockchain infrastructure built for high availability and sub-200ms response times.

projects.title: Cross-chain blockchain infrastructure
projects.summary: Built and maintained Rust-based blockchain infrastructure achieving 99.9% uptime while processing $1M+ in cross-chain transactions over 8 months.
highlights: Maintained 99.9% production uptime across cross-chain transaction processing.
Processed over $1M in cross-chain volume over an 8-month production window.
Monitored wallet infrastructure and on-chain transaction finality across Stellar, Solana, Ethereum and TRON.

diagram.caption: Cross-chain transaction signing, routing and finality verification flow

projects.title: Pan-African fiat on/off-ramp and payment APIs
projects.summary: Designed and implemented scalable backend services supporting 4,000+ active users with sub-200ms API response times across five African countries.
highlights: Integrated Flutterwave, Link and Bridge to run fiat on-ramp and off-ramp flows across five African countries.
Implemented backend integrations for card and payment products, including provider APIs, webhooks and wallet funding.
Kept API response times under 200ms for 4,000+ active fintech users.

diagram.caption: Multi-provider fiat on/off-ramp request and webhook settlement pipeline

projects.title: ClickHouse market data pipeline and exchange fallback
projects.summary: Designed a high-performance data pipeline to synchronise 5+ months of historical Forex and crypto data into ClickHouse, paired with a four-exchange price fallback layer.
highlights: Synchronised 5+ months of historical Forex and crypto tick data into ClickHouse for rapid strategy validation and parameter optimisation.
Designed a multi-exchange price fallback layer across Coinbase, Kraken, Bitfinex and Binance to improve market-data availability and resilience.

diagram.caption: Multi-exchange market feed ingestion, failover routing and ClickHouse storage

projects.title: Crypto infrastructure and volume telemetry dashboard
projects.summary: Built an internal crypto infrastructure dashboard giving stakeholders clear, live visibility into transaction volume and network activity across blockchain rails.
highlights: Surfaced live transaction volume and wallet activity across supported blockchain networks.
Collaborated with the engineering lead on backend architecture, database operations and production reliability.

diagram.caption: On-chain indexer aggregation and live stakeholder telemetry readout
